records.name: Philadelphia Ethical Society
records.summary: A humanist community at Rittenhouse Square that holds free Sunday talks with a guest speaker and live music, followed by discussion. Anyone can come to the Sunday talks in person or online.
records.what_you_do: Attend a Sunday talk, stay for the discussion afterward, and come to the society's public civic and arts events.

schedule.text: Sunday talks starting at 11 AM, with a guest speaker, live music and discussion

cost.text: Sunday talks are free and open to the public

first_step.how: Come to a Sunday talk in person, or join the live stream (the Zoom link is sent to the mailing list)
first_step.basis: Sunday talks are free and open to the public, but the site has no first-visit guide

records.notes: Found from the Meetup philosophy topic page (Meetup used as a lead only). Dated events on its own site run through October 2026. The footer email on the site is a placeholder, so the office address was used instead.

records.name: Alliance Française de Philadelphie
records.summary: The French cultural center in Philadelphia. It runs French conversation classes, informal French meals around the city, and monthly book clubs for adults and teens.
records.what_you_do: Join a current-events conversation class (intermediate and advanced only), a French-speaking meal at a restaurant, or a monthly book club discussed in French.

schedule.text: Recurring French conversation classes, French Tables meals and monthly book clubs. The day and time of each one are on its upcoming-event pages.

locations.label: Office (events are held at varying venues)

first_step.how: Email alliance@afphila.com or open the upcoming-event page for the event you want
first_step.basis: The Newsroom is for intermediate and advanced learners only, and the site does not say how a beginner starts with the other events

records.notes: Cost, day and time are not on the recurring-events page, and the individual upcoming-event pages were not read. The 2026 status rests on a Bastille Day 2026 review link and a 2026 footer, not a dated event. Found through the Meetup French and culture topic search results (Meetup used as a lead only).

records.name: America-Italy Society of Philadelphia
records.summary: A nonprofit that links Philadelphia with Italy through Italian language courses, conversation classes, film nights, concerts and an Italian book club.
records.what_you_do: Take a term of Italian classes or a conversation class, or come to the film nights, concerts and book club meetings listed on its calendar.

schedule.text: Language courses run in terms: the fall term runs September 28 to December 19, and winter enrollment is coming soon. Film, concert and book club events are listed by date.

locations.label: Language school
locations.address: 230 S. Broad St., Suite 1105, Philadelphia, PA

first_step.how: Contact the front desk at ais.frontdesk@aisphila.org or call 215-735-3250 about the next term or an event
first_step.basis: The site lists courses and events but does not say whether membership is needed to join classes

records.notes: Course prices and membership rules are not on the pages read. The term year is inferred from a winter 2027 enrollment note. The membership page returned 404, so the home page was used. Found through an Italian language search (the Meetup Italofili group is listed separately as a lead).

notes: Platform use: 9 of 12 Meetup pages (6 topic listings, 3 group pages), all read at human pace, no login, no RSVP. Join Philly was not used. Searches: all 8 spent. Only 3 records were written because most Philadelphia language and culture groups found on Meetup had no website of their own, and the search budget ran out before more could be verified. Out of area and not recorded: the New York and Toronto online exchanges, Language Exchange New York, Alliance Française Princeton, Linguallama (North Jersey and online), Pep Talk Radio online, Japanese and English exchanges on Zoom, Enjoy Japanese NY, NY Japanese Language Community, Lehigh Valley Students of Stoicism, Chicago Korean-English conversation table, and the online Global Stoa. Dates were checked against today, 2026-10-08. Several Meetup topic results were the same groups in different lists. Suggested next step for a later wave with search budget: check the Italofili, Netzwerk Philadelphia and Free Library Spanish groups from a non-platform source, and read the Alliance Française upcoming-event pages for days, times and prices.
